name: icalp-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ICALP, the EATCS International Colloquium on Automata, Languages, and Programming: routing a theory result between Track A (algorithms, complexity, games) and Track B (automata, logic, semantics), the February deadline plus Track B's new September round, lightweight double-blind HotCRP submission, the no-page-limit full version whose first ten pages must carry the result, AI-use disclosure, proof rigor in place of artifact evaluation, LIPIcs (Dagstuhl) open-access camera-ready, and the Track B rebuttal. Grounded in the ICALP 2027 (54th, Kraków) Track B call and committees pages re-verified on 2026-11-24, the ICALP 2026 call, EATCS pages, LIPIcs/Dagstuhl, and dblp.
